warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.50 + 3.00 (6.50); y = A-B-C-D-E at 4.00 + 2.25 + 1.75 + 2.00 (10.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01 (both views), S-02, S-03, the truss elevations and A-07/A-08. Vector PDF whose Thai text layer is a legacy font encoding (unreadable as text) - every value read off the rendered page.

Truss elevations (S-04 T1/T5/T2, S-05 T3/T4) print no grid bubbles, but their support chains (3.50 + 3.00 = 6.50, 4.00 + 4.00 = 8.00, 3.00, 2.00) match the grid spans the S-03 roof frame plan places them on (T1 rows A and B, T5 row D, T2 row E 2-3, T3 along x 1''''' from D to A, T4 along 2''' from E to D), so their panel ticks were positioned off those grid lines and became dummies per section 4 rule 4.

The roof ridge (Truss T3) is at x = 3.25 (1'''''), 0.25 left of grid 2 - the midpoint of the 8.50 eave-to-eave width; S-03 prints 3.25 + 0.25 and both T1/T5 elevations print 0.25 + 0.25 about the apex. 3.00 on y (A''''') is both the S-01 beam line and a T3 panel tick - one line.

z: +-0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน (A-07/A-08). Two different levels share the printed label ระดับหลังอกไก่ (+4.66 carport ridge, +5.67 main ridge), so their ids carry the value. ระดับฝ้าเพดาน prints no value (level_m null). Truss depths (T1/T5 2.02, T2 1.01, T3 0.55 below +5.67) are member dimensions and stay on the truss elements in the S-04/S-05 files, not z ticks.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-07 plus A-07/A-08 (building sections, for levels). S-06/S-07 print only member-internal dimensions (cap sizes, depths, section sizes), which stay on their elements. The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03..A-06, A-09, A-10, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run; A-03/A-04/A-05/A-06 repeat the main chains and A-04 the 1.00 roof overhangs.
